script.problem: It has 7 sentences. Each paragraph is 3 to 4 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage does not say that the people the Lord had in Corinth were people Paul had not yet met. Crispus and many Corinthians had already believed before the vision.
The promise that the Lord had many people in Corinth was given specifically to Paul; the passage does not promise every reader that the Lord has more people in their city than they know.
